Maya: Quick random idea — weeknight MLS penalty-shootout pick'em? Loser brings donuts on Friday? :soccer: :donut:
Devon: I'm down. How do picks work — just pick the team that wins the shootout? $2 pool? :coin:
Carlos: I'll take D.C. United to win it. Also happy to set up snack table if I lose. :muscle:
Priya: Ooh spicy. I will pick the keeper to make the decisive save (wildcard pick). If it breaks the tie I win bragging rights. :eyes:
Maya: OK rules proposal: each person picks team OR keeper, tie resolved by coinflip. No pressure on $ if people prefer donuts only. Sign up format below and ping me when you pick. @here
Maya: ```
Name | Pick (team or keeper) | $ or donuts
Maya | RSL | donuts
Devon | ? | $
```
ops-bot: Poll created: "MLS shootout picks" — 5 responses so far. (automated reminder in 2h)
Devon: I'll go RSL. $2 from me. Whoever loses owes a box of Krispy Kreme? :grimacing:
Carlos: Confirmed: D.C. United, donuts if I lose.
Priya: Keeper pick: "M. Santos" (big brain move). Donuts waived if keeper wins? joking. :sweat_smile:
Maya: Nice. Also tiny side bet: loser pulls snack duty AND creates a 2-min highlight reel for the next all-hands. Stakes elevated. :trophy:
Devon: Wait no the highlight reel. I'm out of pants. Just kidding, in.
Carlos: This is very office-y. Love it. Can someone stash the buy-in cash in the snack fund jar? I can collect.
Maya: I'll keep track. If anyone changes pick reply in-thread so it's visible. Reminder: picks lock at kickoff (in ~3h). Good luck :soccer:
Priya: May the best wildly overconfident person win. :crossed_fingers:
